title: Yang-Mills-Higgs: A Geometric Theory of Binary Labels on Non-Contractible Spaces
summary: We reformulate binary classification on a manifold M as a Yang-Mills-Higgs variational problem. Labelled data is encoded as a functor from the fundamental groupoid of M to the one-object groupoid B(Z_2), whose monodromy class in H^1(M, Z_2) is a topological obstruction to realising the classifier by a sign function. The classifier-section and the connection jointly minimise a Yang-Mills-Higgs energy subject to hard data conditions: the matter sector carries the classification content, while the Yang-Mills sector is bounded below in each topological class by the Bogomolny inequality and…
